request: 对 你说得对 那你再重新分析一下应该怎么生成 并且生成几个试试看哪个好
analysis: 认可正面的压力与辨识感，一部分来自直接、持续的注视。此前画外上望让画面更容易读成寻找回应或戒备，视线与观看者的关系应独立检查。
先前反复要求嘴部收住、眼周增加张力，可能使表演过于拘谨；这是对提示效果的推测，不能视为已证明的因果。改为保留自然唇形与眼睑，让稳定注视和自在体态承担主要表现。
面孔身份、气质和三分之四转角是三个不同验收项。脸看起来更像，不代表角度足够；阴影更深，也不代表更符合人物。
A、B换为左转探索姿态，C作为沿原右转方向、较少新增表情要求的比较。三种输入与角度不完全相同，是探索性方案比较，不是严格单变量实验。

assistant_preference.qualification: 初次助手判断保留为过程记录；作者随后表示三张都不太喜欢，并明确C气质也非所需，当前没有选中图。

assets.qa: 左侧转面比另外两张明显，两眼与远侧脸呈现透视收窄，头颈较端正、画外注视较平稳。侧转结构较便于继续复核，但眉眼稍显认真、严肃，嘴部仍有绷紧感；是否具备人物的从容而非戒备，需要作者判断。
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE photorealistic color portrait of this same established fictional adult man, preserving his specific face across a change of angle.
Image 1 is the primary identity reference. Image 2 is the same man in directional light and supplies the quality of steady attention only. Keep the recognizable eye and brow shapes, nose, natural lip shape and mouth width, cheekbone and jaw proportions, youthful adult age, and the continuous subtly angular chin without a deep cleft. Keep natural substance in the lower face; do not taper it into a pointed or delicate face.
Same short dark wavy hair, gray-dominant pale gray-blue irises with restrained reflections, black shirt and dark textured jacket, subdued architectural interior. Hair volume and head-to-shoulder proportion stay natural. No added age, accessories, text or collage.
Eye-level camera, natural portrait perspective, vertical 3:4 framing including the head and enough upper chest and shoulders to show a supported posture. Use readable directional window light: a clear illuminated plane and broad soft cheek shadow, natural skin exposure and texture, sufficient fill to read both eyes. The mood should come from the person's attention, not from making the image extremely dark.
Keep the lips in their original natural resting shape and the brow in its original position. Do not instruct a forced expression: no pursing, clamping the mouth, over-squinting, raised searching eyebrows, sleepy eyelids, conspicuous anger or posing for a fashion photograph.

VARIANT A — SELF-POSSESSED, LOOKING PAST THE CAMERA:
Show a definite LEFT-FACING three-quarter view (nose points toward the viewer's LEFT), about 45 degrees from frontal. Both eyes are visible, the far eye and cheek narrower by perspective. The shoulders and torso are also turned slightly left, with the head aligned naturally over the torso. He is comfortably supported in the chair, shoulder line settled, chin level, neither leaning forward to please someone nor shrinking back.
His eyes follow the direction of his face, looking HORIZONTALLY at a person at his own eye height off-frame to the left. He has already settled his attention there. The visible behavior is very quiet: a sustained look, natural breathing, an unhurried resting mouth. He listens without giving immediate reassurance or agreement. He is at ease with being watched and with letting the silence continue. Preserve the approved man's inward, reserved presence without acting suspicious, startled or weary.

Use case: identity-preserve.
This single image is the approved fictional character and the ONLY reference. Make one believable new photograph of this exact man from a three-quarter camera angle. Preserve his face and the expression he ALREADY has; do not redesign him or invent a stronger emotional performance.

Move the camera approximately 45 degrees to his left, keeping camera height level with his eyes. His nose now points toward the viewer's RIGHT and both eyes remain visible, with the farther eye and cheek foreshortened. He continues looking at the same person in front of him, keeping the original focused gaze and natural resting lips. His own gaze stays horizontal. Retain the original head-to-neck relationship as naturally viewed from the new camera position.

Translate his original facial proportions into perspective faithfully: eye and brow shapes, nose-lip-chin relation, cheek and jaw width, lower-face length, and continuous subtly angular chin. Preserve the original skin tone and texture, youthful adult age, pale gray-blue eye color, short dark wavy hair, black shirt and dark textured jacket. No pinching the cheeks, narrowing or sharpening the chin, added wrinkles, pout or new scowl.

Keep directional light from the same environment with enough reflected fill to read the shadow-side eye and jaw. Do not deepen the shadows beyond the reference. Vertical 3:4 head-and-upper-chest portrait, natural portrait lens perspective, subdued architectural interior, no text, collage or extra objects. Treat this as another camera seeing the approved performance, not a new character portrait.
